hookups.source: https://www.lpcgov.org/services/fairgrounds/ ('6 seasonal RV hook-up sites including: 2 sites with 50-amp service, 4 sites with 30-amp service, All sites include water hookups, No Dumping') + https://laplata.rja.revize.com/app/bookable-groups/RV_Space ('Water access is shared between 2 sites. A 50' hose is recommended'; 'There is no dumping facility on-site. Grey water dumping is prohibited'). The stored water 'false' came from note prose ('shared water'); the county calls it a water hookup. Read 2026-10-27

values.note: Six back-in sites: #1-2 50 amp, #3-6 30 amp, each with two 110 plugs on the 50-amp posts. One water faucet per two sites (bring a 50-ft hose and a pressure reducer). No site lengths published.

sites.source: https://laplata.rja.revize.com/app/bookable-groups/RV_Space ('RV Site #1 - 50 AMP' ... 'RV Site #6 - 30 AMP'; 'All sites are BACK IN ONLY'; 'The water pressure at each site is high'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Restrooms in the Extension Building, weekdays 8-5 (after hours by calling maintenance); showers for a fee at the Durango Community Recreation Center next door.

facilities.source: https://laplata.rja.revize.com/app/bookable-groups/RV_Space ('Restrooms are available in the Extension Building ... Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM'; 'We do not have showers available on site'; 'There is no dumping facility on-site'; 'WIFI Information - Network Name: LPCWireless'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Unhook from the faucet if the temperature falls below 32 degrees.

season.source: https://www.lpcgov.org/services/fairgrounds/ ('The 2026 RV season runs from April 1 through October 31, 2026') + https://laplata.rja.revize.com/app/bookable-groups/RV_Space ('Our RV Season is open from April 1st to October 31st'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Book online on the county's reservation site; questions to the RV park manager at 970-382-6465 weekdays 8-5. Advance reservation required - after-hours arrivals without one are turned away. Cancellation needs three business days' notice. Check-in noon, check-out 11 a.m.

booking.source: https://www.lpcgov.org/services/fairgrounds/ ('2026 New Online RV Reservation System: Please make your 2026 RV reservations online! ... call at 970-382-6465'; 'Guests arriving after hours without a confirmed reservation will not be permitted to stay in the park'; 'Advance reservations are required for all RV spaces') + https://laplata.rja.revize.com/app/bookable-groups/RV_Space ('Reservations must be completed no later than noon on the day of arrival. You are only able to stay 14 consecutive nights'; 'Three business days' notice is required for a refund'), read 2026-10-27

fees.source: https://www.lpcgov.org/services/fairgrounds/ ('The Fairgrounds offers 6 seasonal RV hook-up sites including: $29/night'), read 2026-10-27

note: Six RV sites at the La Plata County Fairgrounds in Durango (2500 Main Ave), on the northeast side of the grounds just north of the Fred Klatt Arena; enter from North Main and 25th Street. Nearest dump station: the Speedway gas station on US-160. Animas River Trail within walking distance. --Claude
summary: County fairgrounds page + its online RV booking page (per-site descriptions): confirmed 6 back-in sites, 50/30 amp, no sewer/dump, reservations required. Changed water false -> true ('All sites include water hookups', a faucet shared by two sites), season mid-April-September -> April 1-October 31 (2026 season), fees added $29; booking platform phone -> the county's online system (deep link, noon same-day cutoff, 14 nights, fcfs never); added no showers, WiFi, restroom note. Note: dropped the field restatements, the old season and $28, and 'big-rig friendly' (no lengths published).
